scoring_justification: The paper reports qualitative trends (oscillations, decay, periodicity) without exact numeric gold; structural checks on the computed ΔE_n sequences verify the three coupling behaviors.

outputs.description: Interlayer magnetic coupling energy per atom for four superlattice systems as a function of spacer thickness. The checker assesses whether the sequences follow the three qualitative coupling behaviors described in the paper.

output_contract.notes: The scoring is based on structural trends, not numerical precision. The agent must faithfully implement the self-consistent tight-binding recursion method; exact parameter values (Slater-Koster integrals, lattice constants, band fillings, exchange/coulomb integrals) are provided in the method section of the instruction. No hidden gold value is required for numeric comparison.

steps.description: Verify qualitative trends for all four systems: Friedel oscillations (Fe-V, Co-Ru), exponential decay (Co-Pd), parity oscillations (Fe-Cr).
